source: Basketball-Reference.com, fetched Nov 12, 2026: 2026-27 player contracts (contracts/players.html: this season's salary and the number of seasons with a salary listed) and the 30 team roster pages (height, birth date, birth country, head coach). The 2026-27 salary cap is $164,961,000 (contracts summary).
notes: Two-way and Exhibit 10 deals are not on the contracts page; those players have no salary here. Birth country is where he was born, not always his national team. Option years are not marked in the source text, so every listed season counts. A player still paid by a club that waived him appears twice in the source; his salary here is his current deal's guaranteed amount.
